mapper.select: select biz_id as bizId, template_id as templateId, channel_type as channelType, message_type as messageType, receiver, receiver_count, title, content, delay_minutes as delayMinutes, schedule_time as scheduleTime, retry_count as retryCount, status, success_count, fail_count, send_time as sendTime, create_time as createTime from message_record where template_id = #{templateId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_record ( biz_id, template_id, channel_type, message_type, receiver, receiver_count, title, content, delay_minutes, schedule_time, retry_count, status, success_count, fail_count, send_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{bizId}, #{templateId}, #{channelType}, #{messageType}, #{receiver}, #{receiverCount}, #{title}, #{content}, #{delayMinutes}, #{scheduleTime}, #{retryCount}, #{status}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{sendTime}, NOW() )
